verifications.claim: A two-hour delay means school, work, or transport services start 120 minutes later than their regularly scheduled time.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Student pick up time will be two hours later than it normally is." (R1); "Schools and Offices open 2 hours late" (R3); "school opening would be delayed for two hours" (R4); "all Chesapeake Schools will begin two hours later than the normal start time (students and staff should arrive two hours after...)" (R6); "PWCS classes will begin two hours late... A.M. bus transportation will operate on a two-hour delay... employees... report for work two hours late" (R7); "students should arrive at school two hours later... school buses will run their routes two hours later" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly confirm that schools, staff/work, and bus/transport start exactly two hours (120 minutes) later.

verifications.claim: Bus pickups, classes, and morning programs typically operate exactly two hours later than normal.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Student pick up time will be two hours later..." (R1); "Morning kindergarten starts at 9:50 a.m." (two hours later, R4); "all Chesapeake Schools will begin two hours later" (implies classes, R6); "PWCS classes will begin two hours late. A.M. bus transportation will operate on a two-hour delay." (R7); "school buses will run their routes two hours later than normal." (R8)
verifications.reasoning: References explicitly state buses and classes start two hours later; morning programs like kindergarten follow suit.

verifications.claim: In a 2-hour delay, if school usually starts at 8:00 a.m., it will start at 10:00 a.m.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Schools and Offices open 2 hours late" (R3); "A two-hour delay would mean that school opening would be delayed for two hours... School begins at 9:50 a.m." (implies +2 hours, R4); "all Chesapeake Schools will begin two hours later than the normal start time" (R6); "Schools will Open Two Hours Late... classes will begin two hours late." (R7); "students should arrive at school two hours later than their normal start times." (R8)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant references confirm school start is exactly two hours later, directly supporting the example arithmetic.
